contract: Append-only, initially size=capacity=0. Store costs1; copying each existing element costs1. Allocation/zeroing/bytes/timing excluded. Doubling starts capacity1; fixed growth adds k slots on each full append. Phi=2n-capacity only for doubling. Domain N0..128,k1..32. All invalid drafts retire the accepted observation until Apply.
independent_formula: For n>0, doubling capacity P is the least power of2>=n and total=n+P-1. Fixed growth has r=floor((n-1)/k), capacity=(r+1)k, total=n+k*r*(r+1)/2. At zero both capacities/totals are0. These formulas are evaluated separately from the state-transition implementation.
review_scope: Frozen by the same contributor before implementation. This is a separate oracle, NOT independent-worker or human acceptance.
